name: lammps.js
description: Run LAMMPS directly in the browser — a WebAssembly build with TypeScript-ready bindings.

scripts.copy:types: mkdir -p dist/types dist/cpp && cp types/index.d.ts types/client.d.ts dist/types/ && cp cpp/lammps.d.ts cpp/lammps-kokkos.d.ts dist/cpp/ && node scripts/ensure-kokkos-stub.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:dist
scripts.build:kokkos: npm run build:wasm:kokkos && npm run build:dist
scripts.test:kokkos: npm run build:kokkos && vitest run tests/kokkos.spec.ts
